dataset_info.summary: A breadth-first sampler that gives every registered speech locale a board without waiting for the full corpora: 100 clips per language, drawn at fixed intervals rather than from the top of the file. The clips come from telephone banking speech, spoken assistant commands and read speech, split evenly when a language has more than one source. One hundred clips is enough to rank engines roughly and too few to separate close rivals.
dataset_info.notes: Balanced representative sampler for arena leaderboards: 100 clips per language drawn deterministically (index-strided, not first-N) from MInDS-14 (banking), Speech-MASSIVE (assistant) and FLEURS ca_es/gl_es (read-speech) — 50/50 split when a locale has two sources (de-DE, es-ES, fr-FR, ko-KR, nl-NL, pl-PL, pt-PT, ru-RU) — so a new board can breadth-first cover every registered STT locale before the full per-corpus datasets accrete.
